source.sourceText: When this creature enters, you may discard a card. If you do, search your library for a creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

sink.sourceText: Search your library for a creature card (needs a creature card in library to find).
{1}, {T}: Untap another target permanent (unrestricted — can target your own other permanents).
{1}, {T}: Untap another target permanent (unrestricted — can equally target an opponent's permanent).
